entry.title: [要確認] pip: Pillow: Heap buffer overflow saving TIFF with libtiff when tags override image size (HIGH)
entry.content:
Claudeの仕分け：要確認 HIGH。libtiffでTIFFを保存するときだけヒープの書き込みがあふれる
→ Pillow 13.0.0 以降に更新

Pillow <= 12.3.0 → 13.0.0

CVE-2026-128067

entry.title: [様子見] pip: Pillow: Memory DoS in TIFF and EXIF IFD parsing via overlapping tag data (MEDIUM)
entry.content:

→ Pillow 13.0.0 以降に更新
